lines.1: 「That's rich coming from the person who wrecks that balance more than anyone.」
lines.2: 「For starters, everyone, the blackboard is still dirty.」
lines.4: 「The flowers are looking rather wilted as well.」
lines.6: 「And it's dirty around the teacher's desk.」

lines.14: 「Please take this opportunity to reflect on your own behavior.」

lines.18: 「Princess, do you think Yoshimi caught a cold?」
lines.19: 「Hmm. The thing is, I can't get through to her phone.」
